HediffDef.label: ether shell
HediffDef.description: Protects the caster or an allied pawn from vacuum and extreme cold for one day. Grants full vacuum resistance, prevents vacuum burns and lowers minimum comfortable temperature by 300 C. Does not protect from bullets, fire or heat, and does not heal injuries. Cannot stack or refresh while active.

TorannMagic.TMAbilityDef.label: Ether Shell
TorannMagic.TMAbilityDef.description: Protects the caster or an allied pawn from vacuum and extreme cold for one day. Grants full vacuum resistance, prevents vacuum burns and lowers minimum comfortable temperature by 300 C. Does not protect from bullets, fire or heat, and does not heal injuries. Cannot stack or refresh while active. Range: 12 cells. Preparation: 1 second. Cooldown: 60 seconds. Costs 25% mana before efficiency modifiers.

ThingDef.label: Mage Spell: Ether Shell
ThingDef.description: Teaches Ether Shell to a mage able to learn general spells. Protects the caster or an allied pawn from vacuum and extreme cold for one day. Grants full vacuum resistance, prevents vacuum burns and lowers minimum comfortable temperature by 300 C. Does not protect from bullets, fire or heat, and does not heal injuries. Cannot stack or refresh while active.

ThingDef.label: ether shell cast scroll
ThingDef.description: Protects the caster or an allied pawn from vacuum and extreme cold for one day. Grants full vacuum resistance, prevents vacuum burns and lowers minimum comfortable temperature by 300 C. Does not protect from bullets, fire or heat, and does not heal injuries. Cannot stack or refresh while active. Use from inventory. Consumes one scroll on a successful cast. Anyone can use it without mana or learned magic. Fixed one-day duration; range 12 cells, preparation 1 second, cooldown 60 seconds.
